title: Add Memory, Routing, and Fallbacks
core_invariant: Working memory is ephemeral workflow state; persistent memory is scoped and provenance-bearing. Retrieve deliberately; do not append the whole store. Expired and superseded entries are flagged or excluded. Routing is explicit predicates, not a hidden prompt; no-match is first-class. Fallbacks are a bounded ladder; a circuit breaker is orchestration policy. Degraded success is labeled and is not silent incorrect success. Predict before every robustness action. Transfer without assistance. Generic WP-137 metric and table blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame memory, routing, and bounded fallbacks
stages.instructions: Restate the M38 workflow: explicit AgentState, checkpoints, approval, loop bounds. M39 adds provenance-bearing memory, explicit routes (at least two classes plus no-match), and a bounded fallback/circuit (robust_version v10-teaching-robust-1, circuit_threshold 2, max_attempts 3, catalog_price 42.0, stale_price 99.0). Identify gate evidence: relevant versus irrelevant retrieval, stale/superseded exclusion, route correctness, degraded primary failure, circuit-open on repeated failure, a no-AI robustness design, and a V10 memory/routing/fallback ADR. Do not open an eval harness, RAG, or LangGraph SDK. No custom frontend.

stages.title: Read retrieve, route, fallback ladder, circuit
stages.instructions: Read retrieve_memory, select_route, run_fallback_ladder, and repair_run without importing a store SDK. Predict expired ids are excluded, name retrieved ids/route/attempts/degraded as live probes, and that no-match does not wrap M38. Submit an annotated robustness trace.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace names the live contract and a rejected or illegal path.

stages.title: Predict, then run the robustness layer
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the generic runtime. (1) PREDICT a SKU-7 purchase routes catalog_purchase, posts 42.0, excludes stale 99.0 memory, and stays non-degraded; forced primary failure yields a labeled degraded terminal with effect_count 0. (2) COMMIT. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the teaching robustness layer; emit WP-137 metric of route, degraded, circuit_open, stale_excluded, posted_amount and a table of retrieved versus excluded ids. (4) OBSERVE. (5) SUBMIT / EXPLAIN. Do not silently complete on stale memory.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; submitted explanation covers the observed WP-137 blocks. No universal accuracy threshold.

stages.title: Diagnose stale-memory trust and fallback oscillation
stages.instructions: Named faults, one change each. Fault A: post expired memory as complete (stale 99.0). Predict posted_amount is 99.0 and complete. Repair_run posts catalog 42.0 from the M38 lookup; original still posts stale. Fault B: ignore circuit and attempt bounds so primary/fallback oscillate. Repair opens the circuit at the configured bound; original still exceeds max_attempts. Emit a WP-137 table of posted_amount and attempts.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract from the broken object.

stages.title: Defend robustness without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, without inventing an eval harness, classify working versus persistent memory, list provenance fields, route two fresh tasks plus no-match, bound a fallback, and diagnose stale trust. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 artifact. Leave responses unfilled.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the contract, a valid repair, and does not invent deferred machinery.

stages.title: Choose a V10 memory, routing, and fallback policy
stages.instructions: Complete an ADR for V10 memory/routing/fallback policy: persistence, provenance, retrieval scope, route precedence, bounds, degraded outputs, and circuit breaking. Reject append-all memory and unbounded retry. Do not implement an eval harness here.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a decision, rejected alternative, owner, status, and date.

stages.title: Hand M40 declared robustness surfaces
stages.instructions: Hand M40 a robust agent with declared memory, route, fallback, and trace surfaces. Not an eval harness, RAG pack, or LangGraph SDK store.

stages.title: Evaluate memory-routing-fallback evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, robustness experiment, stale-memory/oscillation diagnosis, and unassisted transfer. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from a silent incorrect complete.
